meta.title: One-round event: the vendor can quote again on a regretted line, but the line stays flagged
gaps: The vocabulary has no operation to mark a line as regretted, so the starting state is not fully created.
The vocabulary cannot verify that the line remains flagged or that the new bid carries no regret.
The vocabulary cannot verify the absence of price-check or submit-check errors 736 and 800.

words.preconditions: A fresh published RFQ event where the invited QA vendor has submitted a bid; bidding still open.
steps: The invited QA vendor places a complete bid (open, price, submit).
As the buyer, read the pricing round and check that “bid count” equals 1.
words.expected: The app accepts it. Read back afterwards: “bid count” equals 1.
